risk_note: F1-08aj (orchestrator D10-1517 batch 1 item 1, third of three). The admin withdrawal detail page gets 立即查询 and 人工处置 for a PAYING withdrawal with needs_manual=true, shown only with payout.execute (hidden otherwise). 立即查询 goes through the shared StepUpModal (totp, BR-ID-34) and sends exactly one POST /admin/v1/withdrawals/{id}/query; the page says the query was submitted and re-reads the detail, never shows a status change and never sends any transfer or execute request (BR-WDR-14). 人工处置 requires a resolution (paid / failed) and the proof text (not blank, at most 4000 code points), and with paid the channel serial and paid time; then 确认处置, step-up, exactly one POST …/resolve with the exact contract body (failed carries no channel_order_id or paid_at). Every 20001 data.reason of the contract gets its own message (the resolve_* sentences of BR-TEXT-14 table B), the dialog stays with what was typed; 20902 refreshes; failed is refused by the server today (D10-625 / D10-626) and the page only shows the reason. Idempotency-Key: kept on 10003 and on every unsettled failure (network, 40901, 5xx), renewed after a success. Codex is out of quota until 2026-11-20 (D10-1604), so per ops/approvals.yaml #36 the rule tests were written by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh, fresh context; ledger tester claude-independent, #121): 21 tests in 4 files; independent Claude spec-test r1 pass with one S2 (no test of a 5xx keeping the key; required in the implementation brief). Red on couli-ci for the spec commit (21 tests, right reason). Implementation by Opus 5.5 (another context); couli-ci verify:fast run 3 green (run 2 had one red: a status name hard-coded in texts, now read from the admin dictionary) and --browser run 1 green. Written by hand.
